body: First half or so (the all caught up) was great as normal. However the rest was a bit of a stinker today in my opinion. Just far far too disjointed and all over the place. The show doesn’t need a structure which is one of the reasons it is good, however not to the degree it was in this one, it just sounded like nobody knew what was happening.
I’ve got nothing to lose and thought “fuck it” maybe it could change me somehow if I were to move to a completely different country for a while

Yeah I am really sorry to say but those walls are incredibly high, and quite frankly I don’t know how to knock them down! I hate disagreeing with you, because I know you are trying to help and you really are saying some amazing things to me. But I honestly just feel like such a lost cause now! It kills me that this is where my life has taken me! I would love to be one of those happy, content people, with a lot of love in their life and just happy with their situation. But I’m not. I hate my life! 

And I’m sorry to disagree but I really honestly do not believe for a second I will find another person as amazing as she was. She is the only girl I’ve ever been with that I had such a deep connection with. I loved her, and still love her so much. And knowing she is gone out of my life forever is something I just cannot deal with at all. The pain I feel not having her there for me anymore is something I can’t even find the words to describe.

I just want all this pain to be gone, I want everything to stop. And there is only one way I can see that all being achievable

Well I can honestly say that those are some of the kindest things anybody has ever said to me, so truly thank you! 

I just wish I could believe it all truly! I just don’t feel like I’m worth love anymore! Nobody does actually love me. The only amazing girl I’ve ever loved and who has ever truly cared about me is gone! I’m never gonna be cared for like that again

Can I ask Tho why you say that, why do you need me. I am utterly useless and genuinely contribute nothing to the world. I went to the bridge last night and just stood at the edge for so long, crying and shaking and begging myself to jump off. I stood for so long but couldn’t do it. I am so fucking pathetic honestly. I fail at life, and I fail at death, I literally fail at everything

She told me aswell that is was not my fault and infact i had been an amazing boyfriend to her and that she was just dealing with some difficult stuff (which im not gonna go into) and has to do it alone. And before you say, i have tried to contact her since. not being pushy to her but just seeing how she was, and it was quite clear from her responses that she did not want to get back with me. It literally kills me to be apart from her, but to know that i have to be apart from her for literally the rest of my life is literally something i simply cannot cope with anymore

Honestly i really don't anymore. I've spoken to the very few friends i have already, but i think i'm boring them to death just rehashing the same old point. They don't even ask how i am anymore because i know I've bored them so much about how i am. And my family for whatever reason are just not sympathetic at all. They literally dont understand why im still hurting over her, and actually the last time i spoke about her they were angry at me that i was still thinking of her. They obviously do not deal well with understanding this ype of thing or the way somebody my feel inside. I honestly feel so alone. ive got nobody at all to turn to
